samples.question: The picture shows a wide horizontal band of small dark grey rectangles on a plain pale background, and below the band five upright bars of equal size and shape: one black bar on the left and four coloured bars, one red, one green, one blue and one orange. Inside the band one arrangement of rectangles is repeated over and over from left to right, always shifted by the same fixed horizontal distance, so the whole band maps exactly onto itself when it is slid sideways by that distance; that repeat distance is drawn nowhere as a line, a gap or a mark, and no rectangle, no edge and no local patch of the band is marked out. Exactly one of the four coloured bars stands to the right of the black bar by exactly that repeat distance. Each of the other three coloured bars stands at a distance that differs from every whole number of repeats by at least 18 pixels, so no other bar is one repeat, two repeats or any whole number of repeats away. The colours of the bars, their left-to-right order, which bar is nearest or farthest, the number of rectangles, the size of the rectangles, the amount of ink and the position of the band carry no information about the answer. Which coloured bar stands exactly one repeat distance to the right of the black bar? Answer red, green, blue or orange.
